terra.problem: “Solomon asks for cedars” says Hiram’s servants haul the logs to the sea. In this passage, Hiram says they will haul them; the passage then says he supplied the timber, but does not describe the hauling as completed.
“House of the Forest of Lebanon” concerns a building in Solomon’s palace complex, not an event in Lebanon. Lebanon appears in its name.
“The thistle and the cedar” is a story Jehoash tells, not an event that is described as actually happening in Lebanon.
